title: Variables
summary: Variables store values so you can reuse them later. You can think of a variable like a labelled box in memory where you keep a value such as a number or a word. You can change what is inside that box at any time.
sample_question: What is a variable and why is it useful?

title: Loops
summary: Loops let you repeat an action multiple times without copying the same code again and again. They are useful when you want to do something for each item in a list, or repeat something until a condition is met.
sample_question: Explain the difference between a for loop and a while loop.
